snapshot.description: Test survey to validate the in-game SurveyOverlay system works on web prod. Survey fires after the user opens New Mission then goes back 3 times. Uses a new count_and_fire() method on PostHogNativeSurveyBridge that has no web guard, so it works in the web export. Survey ID 019e5a8a-840d-0000-7d68-d43089c0fd61 created in PostHog US project 199773.
